scope: Independent focused code/integrity review of optional branch publication metadata and scoped source-lock/task artifacts. No production execution proof.
reviewed_behaviors: Optional product metadata preserves legacy configs when absent. It rejects extra/missing fields, URL credentials/whitespace/control text and unsafe branch/refspec syntax.

Fresh result gate retains independent .git, UNBORN HEAD, empty worktree/index requirements and validates exact symbolic branch, every effective origin fetch URL and every effective push URL. Wrong or additional push URLs fail before first dispatch.

Product destination appears in judged packets only. Explicit push refspec avoids dependence on default branch or upstream. Complete task instructs no prior-attempt source, no rewriting and no origin changes.
Configured source_lock/tasks overrides resolve strictly below the run root, reject wrong types, path overlap, symlink escape and task child symlinks. Missing override preserves old paths.
Source verification, task generation/verification, observation binding, doctor, freeze, launch preparation and direct judged-start all consume the selected lock/task paths.

Scoped lock bytes are separately frozen and verified before prepared dispatch and direct judged start. The configuration digest binds the selected paths; changing whitespace alone in the lock invalidates frozen launch.
This change does not relax finite approved budget, closed ledger, fresh result, registration, source integrity or observed readiness gates.
Original Run3 configuration and committed source/task inputs remain byte-identical to their preserved comparison.

independent_tests.scope: Observed earlier in this auditor turn; real temporary Git repositories plus mocked runtime/doctor dependencies. No model, room or external remote.

limitations: This audit reviews the listed exact file hashes. Later source changes require review of the new diff.
Publication-target validation is a pre-first-dispatch gate and task instruction, not a continuous Git or network authorization boundary after the run begins.
A branch in shared hosting is the requested workflow; the guide does not explicitly discuss branch-per-attempt hosting. Fresh local independent history remains enforced.
No preflight, source-lock readiness, model or submission success follows from utility tests.
